blocks.text: ILOILO CITY, Philippines — Dangerous heat index levels of up to 43 degrees Celsius are expected to persist in parts of Iloilo province on Thursday and Friday this week (Nov. 5 and 6), raising the risk of heat exhaustion and potentially fatal heat stroke, particularly among people exposed to prolonged outdoor heat. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), in its bulletin issued at 5 p.m. Wednesday, November 4, warned that the heat index in Iloilo City would remain at 42°C on Thursday and Friday, while Dumangas town could experience an even higher level, at 43°C, on Friday.
